participation.context: Left the blank as a blank, and opened no second matter.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Refused a figure and entered the thin house without a number.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Called it thin and would not supply a sum.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Kept the jig, and did not ask what the morning had been.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.quote: I am not setting a figure on this afternoon.

story.body: You closed the day on a thin Errors and a blank in the book. You did not name a sum, and you did not open the morning.

relations.quote: I am not setting a figure on this afternoon.
